subject: Run a Bioconductor package command with input parameters taken from the UI

messages.author: ef60b6348e21b0cc
messages.subject: Run a Bioconductor package command with input parameters taken from the UI
parts:
Hi there,
I'm trying to run a command from a bioconductor package that takes as parameters the ones given from a user interface built with Shiny. Heres is my code:

server.R

library(shiny)
library(RnBeads)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

  observe({
    input$submit
    rnb.options(input$identifiers_column)
    rnb.run.analysis(dir.reports=input$results_dir, sample.sheet=input$sample_annotation,data.dir=input$idat_dir,data.type="infinium.idat.dir")
  })


})

-------------------------------------------------
ui.R

library(shiny)


shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Analysis options"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      helpText("MANDATORY FILES AND DIRECTORIES"),
      textInput('sample_annotation', label='Sample annotation sheet'),
      textInput("idat_dir", label='IDAT directory'),
      textInput("results_dir", label='Report directory'),
      actionButton("submit","Submit")
    ),

    mainPanel(
      img(src = "logo_bioestadistica.png",align='right'),
      h1('HELP',align='center'),
      p("IDAT directory path")
    )
  )
))
------------------------------------------------
Error message


Warning: Unhandled error in observer:  is invalid option
observe({
    input$submit
    rnb.run.analysis(dir.reports = input$results_dir, sample.sheet = input$sample_annotation, 
        data.dir = input$idat_dir, data.type = "infinium.idat.dir")
})


rnb.run.analysis must take the value of parameters given from the user interface and then be executed when pressing the "Submit" button.

Any help would be much appreciated.


Thanks very much in advance.


Sheila
